text:
Matvei Gridin is 20 years old, two seasons removed from the 28th pick, and already playing 16:17 a night in Calgary. Six goals and 14 points through 24 games is 0.58 points a game; forwards picked around him since 2005 managed a median 0.35 in their first season of 20-plus games.

The legs are the first thing you notice. His top speed sits in the 93rd percentile and he has 63 bursts over 20 mph, 94th. The power play is a big part of the line: five of his 14 points have come there.

The last ten games have been quieter, four points where our numbers expected about 6.5, and only 2.0 expected goals on his own shots, so the chances thinned out along with the points. Evolving-Hockey had him near replacement level last season, with weak teammates dragging down his raw on-ice numbers. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking, just eight games, had him carrying the puck in 61% of the time. Watch whether those carries start turning into looks again.
headline: Matvei Gridin is fast, 20 and already ahead of schedule
